tasks.short: Conduct pathology research and present scientific findings

steps.what: Conduct research through study design, investigation, analysis and scientific interpretation
Select scientific findings, checked figures and disclosure limits for presentation
Place selected research figures, captions and references into a presentation template
Check the presentation, present scientific findings and answer audience questions

tasks.design: Use native templates in {DOCS} to format selected, validated findings from {SPREADSHEET}. Research design, analysis, figure selection, interpretation and presentation remain with the pathologist; formatting creates no scientific claims.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated placement of approved figures and captions competes with research and explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can place selected content in fixed layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Produce sound evidence and explain limitations under questioning.
tasks.human_edge: Own scientific interpretation and public explanation.
tasks.altitude: Protect scientific work while reducing repeatable presentation formatting.

reach.task: Check permitted dissemination and figure provenance

evidence.claim: Native presentation templates can format supplied figures and text without deciding scientific meaning; the design and time effect are model knowledge.

assumptions: The pathologist produces validated study findings in s1 and captures figure files, exact captions, units, source references, permitted audience and disclosure restrictions in s2; its 10 hours includes that preparation.
The formatter uses only that packet; missing files, unsupported layouts or uncertain disclosure return to manual preparation and checking in s4.
Try native DOCS templates before custom generation; no patient-record export or autonomous research analysis is proposed.
Four additional focal hours cover template repair, access checks and rendering validation.
The 15-hour formatting share is provisional; if formatting is already automated, the saving is zero.
research_questions: Do native templates save presentation preparation time after packet capture, checking and repairs?

already_counted.description: Scientific content selection and packet capture

approvals.approved_version: Exact rendered slide version, figures, captions, references, disclosure limits and audience; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross 15 minus 4 focal upkeep gives central net 11. E1 range 0-5 allows one-off layouts and existing template use; research and delivery retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify as an expert witness in depositions and trials

steps.what: Testify in depositions or trials by explaining evidence and responding to questions

tasks.design: Retain expert testimony and responses with the pathologist, referring to source evidence in {DOCS}. No reduction is claimed for time spent explaining an opinion or answering cross-examination.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testimony requires accountable responses to unpredictable questions about case evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case documents support preparation and reference.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish observed evidence, inference and uncertainty under questioning.
tasks.human_edge: Give an independent opinion and defend its limits.
tasks.altitude: Own the accuracy and independence of expert testimony.

reach.task: Clarify the evidential scope of testimony

evidence.claim: Expert testimony remains an accountable human activity; no separately measured document preparation burden is assumed.

assumptions: The baseline is testimony and associated evidence clarification, without importing a separate report-writing task.
Questions arise during proceedings; no structured question set or automated answer is assumed.
No new automation service is introduced, so there is no added upkeep.
research_questions: Is there repeated evidence indexing outside testimony that can be measured separately?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Testimony and responses retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeatable scientific presentation formatting while retaining research and testimony.
reach: Clarify testimony scope with legal professionals
role.ambitious_version: A pathologist who spends less time arranging approved figures and retains responsibility for research findings and expert evidence.
